book.name: Matyu
book.title: God tal ol na tongwo ha maing yal Matyu mining bongwo dimia.

content: Ari tal guma hon dongwo onangwo halala dire gala dungwo ha

Ena Perisi yal tau ire, Sadiusi tau ire dire, Yisas mongwo bani ungwi. Urere yu sirin bol tongwi, “tal gumang hon dongwo ta i tibi olanga hanamingiwe, owa, ni God honagi yal monga pamua di hanaminua.”
Ditongure Yisas yu dungwi, “Girungwo hamen egin ongwo hanere, nimin sinamue, ari denamue, dinia, te honmil kwahawa kengwo hanere, nimin sinamue dinua.
Dingiwe, hamen egin ongwo i hanere, maing pir po sinba, tal ta u nima nangwo i pir po sikino?

Ari omaga malinga hobi tal gogo ol wanua. Talongwo ni yalhobi tal guma hon dongwo harala dire gala dine? I pisolo. God hana togu yal Yona hamen haung sui tai dire manala pai molere, hon ere mena ongwo meri irawe, omaga para ere yal ta yu onangwo hananga pamua.” Direre Yisas arihobi aidolere, ere ongwi.
Ha di bole Perisi Sadyusi yalhobi kina marasin yis plawa ala olungure u bir ongwo ha
Ena grang wine ongwo hobiwe, breti tau ire, nala dire, akun ol engwo bani kraung gi dungwo, pisolere, nir digan bina hoibi ongwi.
Pi mongure Yisas yu ditongwi, “Homena breti yis ere gangwo dere, u bir ongwo meri, Perisi Sadiusi yalhobi kina ha dire tal ongwo sidina dire, u bir ongwo namia, pir tekirala dire kwi, han molo.”
Yu dungure grang weni ongwo hobi nin ha diriala olere, yu dungwi, “Na breti ire huminiraya, di na tomua,” di pungwi.
Di pirere, yalhobi nin ha diriala ol mongure, Yisas yu ditongwi, “Breti ire hungarai han dikiminia, talongwo breti dikungwo ha diria ol mone?
Tal ominga irai maing han pa dikino? Na homena breti ana holulu ebir sire ari paib tausen tominga irai pirkinua do. Homena tau ya dungwo gal basket ana holo holo kebena sutani giringarai pirkino?
Te, homena breti ana hol pai muru ana hol pai sutani ari po tausen tominga irai, ere pirkinga pamia. Homena ya dungwo gal basket ana hol pai muru hol pai sutani giringarai pirkino?
Na homena breti ire hungi han dikiminia. Perisi Sadiusi ha dire tal ongwo sidina dire, u bir ongwo namia, pir tekire kwi han monana dire di ni tominua.”
Yu dungure yalhobi, “O, homena breti yis ere gangwiwe, ta han dikimia, Perisi Sadiusi kina ha nir si na tongwo i, a i si pire yu wakinama dire, di na tomua” di pungwi.
Pita Yisas iwe Kraist monua di tibi ol tongwo ha
Ena Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi kina ganba i pisolere, pi Sisaria Pilipai mala ongwi. Pi molere, Yisas yalhobi yu sirin bol pungwi, “Ari Wang Weni na molia, arihobi na hana dangwo talwa dime?”

Dungure yalhobi yu ditongwi, “Yal tau Yon nir bil tongwo yal i mona dimua. Yal tau God hana togu yal Ilaiya mona dimua. Yal tau God hana togu yal Yeremaia mona dimua. Te yal tau hana togu yal ta mona dimua.”
Dungure Yisas sirin bol tere yu dungwi, “Ni yalhobi nin na hana talwa dine?”
Dungure Pita yu ditongwi, “Ni God wang singaba Kraist monua.”
Dungure Yisas yu ditongwi, “Saimon ni yal Yona wang monia, milni pamua. Ha pangwo meri dingiwe, ari ta di ni tekimia, hamen nabe nin nomani ni tongure dinua.

Ni ha dingi kara di hulu tenia, ni hulu dungwo meri monua. Te hulu bolimbani iwe, na ana mini hobi i ku bol eralga pamua. Egere nona pare monangure kwia ya ari tau ure isusu ol terala di onamba, kunu paikinamua.

Ena God kene ongwo hol hona grang hoiri ki miling ni teralua. Ganba bani molere, “Owa, tal ta i onanga pamua” dinangiwe, hamen bani para yu pamua dinamua. Te paikimua dinangiwe, hamen bani ere para paikima dinamua.”
Direre Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi ha di nima pire, yu ditongwi, “Na Kraist molia, yal ta na hana dal tekio.”
Yisas gole hon airalua dungwo ha

Ena Yisas Yerusalem nala dire tal emgi u tibi nangwo awa ha i grang wine ongwo hobi di tibi ol tere yu dungwi, “Na Yerusalem nalgiwe, Yuda ari ha maing oo singaba ire, ha maing kene ongwo yal bir hobi ire, ha maing nir si tongwo yalhobi ire dire, tal gogo ol na tere na sinangwo, golalga pamua. Golere emgi hamen haung sui tai dire pai molere, hon airalga pamua,” direre ha yu di tibi ol tongwi.
Tongure yal Pita Yisas auli nin bangi pire kura ha yu ditongwi, “Yahuno. Ni talongwo gonanga ha di homa ene?”
Yu dungure Yisas inaa dire Pita yu ditongwi, “Seten, ni ere po. God ha dungwo meri dikinia, ari ha dungwo meri dinia. Na pauna bli bonga i paikimua,” dungwi.

Ena Yisas hon ainere grang wine ongwo hobi yu ditongwi, “Yal ta na pir na tere, dolna bolala di pinangiwe, nin gaun nomani si pirkirere, talhan mobin hal wa tere, na gul pire, golalga meri ni ere gul pire golere, na dolna bonania.

Yal ta nin nin gaung pir tere monangwo yal iwe, emgi u talwo nangwo pamua. Yal ta na molga maing nomani si pir na tere grana wine ole moli pire, u talwo nangwo yal iwe, emgi gobari mol panangwo bani panamua.

Ena yal ta ganba bani talhan nomani tere wanamia. Wanamba, emgi talhan hobi hon siina dire aki di tenangwo nomani u wai nam mo? Ta honamua. Tal tobo tenangwo kunu benangure nomani hon i si giu diname? I ta dikinamua.
Ena Ari Wang Weni na molere, Nabe yulang irere, kwia ensel hobi kina ereho uralga pamia. Urere ari para muru tal ol na tongwo meri iwe, na hon ainaa dire yu ol teralga pamia.
Ari Wang Weni na mole uralga haung, omaga malinga hobi tau na na hanere, gonanga pamia, ha di ni tega i ogolo pir molo,” dungwi.
